layers.text: Recolour only. The red frill becomes a dark navy blue frill, colour #1a2a5a, with a thin bright orange rim, colour #fe6d00, and thick orange ray stripes like spokes, navy between them. The dark slate hide becomes a clear deep blue, colour #2b5a9a with #17325f shadows. Nothing red is left. Keep the cream belly, eyes, mouth, spit blob, pose, shapes, black outline and style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
